tasks.title: Clear acquisition signing seed on all completion and abandonment paths
steps: Fix only the acquisition signing-seed field and its lifecycle, preserving all concurrent fixture test changes. Existing SigningSeedField wraps a React Aria Input and ref.value clearing; a real browser observed the submitted seed still in serialized page DOM after successful save. Do not assert an unproven library-internal root cause.

Use a local native uncontrolled password input with associated accessible label, description, required semantics, autocomplete new-password, spellcheck disabled and existing token/focus styling; do not add a controlled value, defaultValue, React secret state, query or mutation variables, storage, logging or URL. An operator must be able to type/paste the seed and the submit request must receive it once; a blank optional update preserves the server-side signer.

Centralize a complete seed reset for create and update: clear live value, defaultValue and any value attribute, and force a fresh field/remount when necessary to prevent React or browser state from restoring the serialized value. Execute on successful and failed server submissions, local-validation failure and early return, cancel/create close, source change, tab or route navigation and component unmount. Safely handle async completion after unmount, avoid wiping unrelated user input, and do not leave retained signer in mutation/query cache or user-facing errors. Ensure aria labels, description associations, focus and keyboard flow remain usable after reset. For unmount retain a safe reference to the actual prior input node before React nulls the parent ref, or use a ref callback teardown; test that detached node itself is cleared, not only the replacement page.

Add behavioral browser DOM regression for the ACTUAL rendered component, not a text search for code or a mocked description. Use isolated synthetic key values and controllable success/error responses or the root-owned disposable real-browser fixture; cover create and update success, server failure, local validation failure, cancellation, source switch, tab/route navigation and unmount. Assert input.value and input.defaultValue empty, getAttribute('value') absent or empty, outerHTML and page.content exclude seed; inspect localStorage/sessionStorage, URL, relevant response payloads and query/mutation state where observable. Verify unrelated form labels and keyboard control still work and blank update does not send a signer. Retain a handle to the removed input before navigation/unmount and assert its live value, defaultValue and value attribute are empty after detachment.

Run web typecheck, focused behavioral browser test, existing web tests and token checks as available. Root owns independent full real-Postgres/source/browser acceptance and current fixture scripts; coordinate any test seam without editing its concurrently owned files. Report exact commands, exit status, skips and actual browser evidence. No backend/schema/generated contract or live credential/deployment changes.

checks.expected: Existing panel tests pass, no source-text-only substitute for browser proof.

acceptance: Actual rendered and previously detached input nodes do not expose the submitted synthetic seed through live/default value, value attribute, outerHTML or page serialization after success, failure, cancel, navigation or unmount.
Create/update remain usable, accessible and retain blank-signer-means-unchanged behavior; no seed in storage, URL, responses or retained query/mutation state.
Root independently reruns real source/platform/browser acceptance; report it only if actually observed.
No fixture data or concurrently owned test files are overwritten.

escalation_triggers: Source anchor changed or concurrent fixture files would need editing.
Actual DOM failure persists after the narrow field reset.
A backend, generated contract or real credential change is required.
Behavioral browser regression cannot be executed; report skipped rather than asserting success.
